description: MNIST test-set label errors confirmed via cleanlab confident-learning (cleanlab v1.0) candidate flagging followed by 5-worker Amazon Mechanical Turk human verification. Indices are index-aligned to the standard 10,000-image torchvision MNIST test set (cross-checked directly against original_test_labels.npy at each id, exact match, no reindexing needed).
methodology: Of the 100 candidate examples cleanlab flagged for mturk review, an example is counted here as a confirmed label error if a majority of the 5 mturk workers rejected the original ("given") label -- i.e. votes against the given label ("guessed" + "neither", or just "guessed" when the given and cleanlab-guessed labels coincide) outnumber votes for it. This reproduces exactly 15 confirmed errors out of the 100 reviewed candidates. "corrected_label" is cleanlab's guessed label when that was itself the majority choice; null (see "note") for the 3 cases where "neither" label won a plurality -- the original label is still confirmed wrong in those cases, just without a single verified replacement.

errors.note: majority of the 5 mturk workers rejected BOTH the original label and cleanlab's guessed correction ('neither') -- no single human-verified replacement label is available from this source, only confirmation that the original label is wrong
